up: Retrieve the first 1000 IC50 activity records for human target CHEMBL1163101 (Serine/threonine-protein kinase/endoribonuclease IRE1). Filter activities where the standard_type is 'IC50' and pChEMBL value is present. For each qualifying activity, return assay ChEMBL ID, target type (from target_dictionary.target_type), organism tax_id, molecule canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type (from activities.standard_type), and pChEMBL value (from activities.pchembl_value). Join activities to assays to obtain assay_id and assay_chembl_id, join target_dictionary on tid, join molecule_dictionary on molecule_chembl_id and compound_structures on molecule_chembl_id for canonical SMILES. Order results by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id. sql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
    td.target_type,
    td.tax_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles,
    md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
    a.standard_type,
    a.pchembl_value
  FROM activities a
  JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
  JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
  JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molecule_chembl_id = md.molecule_chembl_id
  LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.chembl_id = cs.molecule_chembl_id
  WHERE
    td.pref_name = 'Serine/threonine-protein kinase/endoribonuclease IRE1'
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
    AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1163101'
  ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ass.chembl_id
  LIMIT 1000
)
SELECT * FROM ranked;
